decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot integrates two capabilities the firm already masters in precast concrete automation, so it can interpret early results and refine the product, though overlap with B and D could lead to some portfolio consolidation.
Automatic de-shuttering builds directly on the firm's established robotics and formwork-handling knowledge, giving it a strong base to assimilate customer feedback and improve the product.

The profile storage robot is a natural complement to the shuttering systems and draws on the same handling and control know-how, so it fits the firm's existing knowledge base and integrated plant offering.
Automatic shuttering is core to the firm's precast automation expertise, and only one year of market presence is too early to judge, so management retains it to learn from the early results.
